scope: Original ten hit locations, all five already analyzed main exposures per associated target; no V2, development or new validation inputs.

method.topocentric_formula: lambda_bary/(1+BERV/299792.458); exact HARPS_3.8 implementation still to be checked.
method.center_choice: Original hit barycentric peak in barycentric frame; its provisional transformed peak in topocentric frame, except H03/H06=5577.339 and H07=6300.304 Angstrom O I air references.
method.baseline: Linear interpolation of the median flux in left and right sidebands at their median wavelengths.
method.noise_scale: 1.4826 times median absolute deviation of sideband residuals from their median; descriptive only; resampling covariance and line structure are not modeled.
method.v1_runs: Original saved detector run peak falls within +/-0.03 Angstrom of comparison center after frame conversion; no detector retuning.

limitations: A local maximum is chosen inside the fixed core, so ratios are not a significance test.
Instrumental, stellar and atmospheric profiles can mix; sideband structure can change the scale.
Barycentric comparison is not a complete stellar-rest-frame correction; no stellar velocity model is imposed.
Non-repetition is not grounds to reject a transient.
The three O I matches are descriptive evidence, not final raw-detector classification.

summary.interpretation: No absence-alone veto. Near-center peak metrics are descriptive and include a maximum over the fixed +/-0.03 Angstrom core.
